description: UI pass 3: Device Actions and Tools destinations, CreateAside device section, and Open/Send wiring in Library. Depends on FEAT-001 (needsLaunchConfirm, launchableUri, smsToViewUri, encoders, reducers), FEAT-002 (Dialog/ConfirmDialog/Select), FEAT-003 (launchDeepLink with quoting fix, qrDeviceService) and FEAT-004/005 (containers, placeholders, Library menu/details). Review findings addressed here: MEDIUM 1 component test (an imported record shows an alertdialog with Cancel focused), NIT 6 (Device Actions treat '' or unknown activeDevice as no device), carried-over: honest Device Actions (Send saves to Downloads and does not claim display; camera scan permanently disabled with explanation, no handler; no fake success), Wi-Fi generator warning/no persistence of password unless saved, Tools set, notify not used while a QR Dialog is open.
steps: Read context.json, design.md 6.0-6.5 and 7 (tools 1-4), design-review.md finding 1 and 6; read src/services/qrEncoders.ts (launchableUri, smsToViewUri, parseFields, detectType), qrStudioStore.ts (needsLaunchConfirm, markUsed), qrDeviceService.ts, deepLinkService.ts and src/types/deepLink.ts.

src/components/qr-studio/useDeviceActions.ts: given {devices, activeDevice, customPath, notify} exposes `hasDevice = hasAndroidTarget(devices, activeDevice)` (false for '' or serial not in devices - no auto-switch), per-action state idle/running/success/error with double-submit prevention, last-result strip data, results cleared when activeDevice changes; actions openOnDevice(target), sendToDevice(target), captureAndDecode(). Targets are a saved record or the current Create draft. openOnDevice: launchableUri(...) null -> disabled with 'This type is not a launchable link' (wifi/contact/event/text/custom) and 'Invalid phone number' for bad SMS; calls launchDeepLink(serial, uri, undefined, customPath); success updates lastUsedAt via markUsed; Rust 'Activity not started' maps to 'No app on the device handles this link'. MEDIUM 1: if the target is a saved record and needsLaunchConfirm(record) (source !== 'created', undefined => confirm) open a Dialog with role=alertdialog showing the exact URI (monospace, wrapped, scrollable) with buttons 'Open on device' and Cancel, Cancel is data-autofocus; backdrop/Escape = Cancel. The unsaved Create draft never confirms. sendToDevice: rasterise the styled SVG to PNG bytes via canvas, base64, sendQrToDevice; UI text 'Saved to Downloads/<name> on <device>' and states it does not display the image. Results go through notify except while a QR Dialog is open, where errors are shown inline in the Dialog.

DeviceActionsPanel.tsx (replace placeholder): cards for Send to Device, Open on Device (record picker from Library records + 'current Create draft'), Capture & Decode (thumbnail, each decoded value with detected type via detectType, Copy, 'Save to library' creating a record with source 'decoded', Open on device where launchable (confirm applies because source is 'decoded'/unsaved decoded value must also confirm: route decoded values through the same alertdialog), empty result text 'No QR code found on the device screen'), Deep link test (type/choose a URI or use the Deep Link Builder output, optional package, Open via the same confirm rule - typed-by-user URIs from this input do not need confirm but decoded ones do), and 'Scan with camera' ALWAYS rendered, always disabled with aria-disabled="true", no onClick, persistent explanation text exactly in the spirit of design 6.4 (ADB cannot force the device camera to scan; use Capture & Decode or scan the on-screen QR with the phone). With no device: every other action is disabled with aria-disabled and the visible text 'Connect an Android device to use this action' (not tooltip-only). CreateAside (from FEAT-004) gets a compact Device Actions section reusing useDeviceActions for the current draft (Send, Open, Capture) plus the disabled camera note. Add 'Open on device' and 'Send to device' to the Library card Menu, bulk-free, and to the details actions, all through useDeviceActions (same confirm rule).

ToolsPanel.tsx (replace placeholder; left list of 4 tools, one active, preselectable from CreateAside via onOpenTool): (1) Deep Link Builder - scheme required ^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*$, host, path, query key/value rows (URI-encoded), fragment, optional Android package validated ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)+$, live URI preview, buttons Use in Create (type deep-link), Open on Device (via useDeviceActions, deep-link test rule), Copy. (2) Wi-Fi QR Generator - wifi form from qrEncoders, show/hide password (default hidden), Use in Create, visible warning 'The password is embedded in the QR and visible to anyone who scans it', password never written to localStorage unless the user saves a record. (3) QR Decoder from image - file input accept image/png,image/jpeg, drag-drop, paste; 10 MB limit; reads bytes to base64; decodeQrImage; output texts with detected type, Copy, Save to library (source 'decoded'), Open as Create; inline errors for unsupported type (say WebP/GIF are not supported), too large, not decodable; disabled message 'Requires the desktop app' without Tauri. (4) QR Quality Checker - content+style input or 'Use current Create draft' or pick a library record, runs qrQuality plus the round-trip decode, lists findings; the old inline contrast checker is gone from the page (already moved to qrQuality).

Tests: useDeviceActions/DeviceActionsPanel with launchDeepLink, sendQrToDevice and captureAndDecode mocked: with devices=[] or activeDevice='' or activeDevice not in devices every device action (camera is always disabled anyway) is disabled with the visible connect text and invoke is never called; Open on Device for a 'created' record calls launchDeepLink without a dialog; MEDIUM 1 component test: a record with source 'imported' (and one with source undefined, and one 'decoded') shows role=alertdialog containing the exact URI with the Cancel button focused (document.activeElement), Escape cancels and launchDeepLink is not called, confirming calls it once with the exact URI; unsaved Create draft opens without a dialog; sms record converts via smsToViewUri, invalid number disabled; non-launchable types disabled with reason; double-click while running calls once; success shows 'Saved to Downloads/<name> on <device>' text and no 'displayed' claim; camera control has aria-disabled="true", is disabled and clicking it never invokes anything; failures surface the error code/message and are not shown as success; Capture & Decode empty and multi-result; Save decoded creates source 'decoded'. Tools: deep link builder URI encoding of `&`/space/non-ASCII and package validation, wifi generator warning present and password absent from localStorage until saved, decoder happy path/too large/unsupported/non-desktop disabled with the service mocked, quality checker findings. Confirm `grep -rn "qr-placeholder" src` returns nothing.
Run verification (full suite); commit `feat(qr-studio): Device Actions and Tools with launch confirmation`.
acceptance_criteria: The imported/undefined/decoded record alertdialog test passes with Cancel focused and no launchDeepLink call on Escape
Camera scan control is rendered, aria-disabled="true", has no click handler effect and a persistent honest explanation is visible
No placeholder (`qr-placeholder`) remains anywhere in src
findings: DONE, commit 693ffc8 'feat(qr-studio): Device Actions and Tools with launch confirmation' on feat/qr-studio-refactor (local, not pushed). Verified: npx vitest run = 882 pass, only the 2 UNRELATED pre-existing ControlPanel.test.tsx failures (renderer select, scrcpy 5.0.1 commit e00d802); npx tsc --noEmit clean; npm run build ok; cd src-tauri && cargo test --lib 278 pass. `grep -rn qr-placeholder src` is empty. No Rust/Cargo/npm dependency change. NEW FILES (src/components/qr-studio/): useDeviceActions.tsx (hook + launch confirm alertdialog; exports CONNECT_TEXT, NOT_LAUNCHABLE, INVALID_PHONE, NO_HANDLER, launchInfo(target), LaunchTarget {record|draft|decoded|typed}, DeviceActionKey send|open|capture|deeplink|decoded), DeviceParts.tsx (ResultStrip, ActionButton = disabled+aria-disabled+visible reason, DecodedList), DeviceActionsAside.tsx (Create aside section, wired through CreatePanel -> CreateAside deviceActions slot), deviceTargets.ts (draftRenderable, decodedFields, decodedRecordInput source 'decoded'), deviceText.ts (CAMERA_SCAN_EXPLANATION), deepLinkBuilder.ts (build/validate + sessionStorage handoff to Device Actions 'Deep link test'), DeepLinkBuilderTool/WifiTool/DecoderTool/QualityTool.tsx; tests DeviceActionsPanel.test.tsx (26), LibraryDeviceActions.test.tsx, ToolsPanel.test.tsx, CreatePanelDevice.test.tsx, deepLinkBuilder.test.ts. BEHAVIOUR: Open on Device confirm rule = needsLaunchConfirm(record) (source !== 'created', undefined confirms) and ALWAYS for decoded values; unsaved Create draft and typed URIs never confirm. Confirm is Dialog role=alertdialog with exact URI in <pre data-testid=launch-uri>, Cancel has data-autofocus, Escape = Cancel. NOTE: Dialog forces closeOnBackdrop=false for alertdialog, so a backdrop click does NOT cancel (design said backdrop=Cancel); Escape/Cancel do. A launch failure from the dialog stays open with an inline role=alert; notify() is only used when no modal overlay is on the stack (getOverlayStack().some(modal)), so failures while the Library details Drawer or any Dialog is open show only inline in the result strip. Success goes to onStatus toast (container) and a role=status strip. Results/pending dialog are keyed by serial and hidden when activeDevice changes; double submit is blocked per `${serial}:${action}` via a ref. 'Activity not started'/errorCode no_handler => 'No app on the device handles this link'; other failures render '<message> (<errorCode>)' and are logged console.error. Send renders PNG via renderPngBase64(item, 1024), filename qrFileName(name,'png'); success text 'Saved to Downloads/<basename of pathOnDevice> on <device label>. The file is only saved; nothing opens on the device.' (avoid words display/shown in any new copy). Decoded sms: links pass through; SMSTO: uses smsToViewUri. WIRING: DeviceActionsPanel props gained optional draft?: QrDraft and onStatus?; CreatePanel gained optional devices/deviceLabels/activeDevice/customPath; LibraryPanel gained optional devices/deviceLabels/activeDevice/customPath/notify; RecordActions gained openOnDevice, sendToDevice, deviceReason(record,'open'|'send'), deviceState(action) (card menu items 'Open on device'/'Send to device' disabled when reason != null; QrDetails has a Device section with reasons and strips; LibraryPanel renders device.launchDialog). ToolsPanel props are now {store, tool, onSelectTool, draftApi, onOpenCreate, onStatus?, devices?, deviceLabels?, activeDevice?, customPath?, notify?}; tool buttons are in <nav aria-label=Tools> with aria-current on the active one (data-tool is on the <section>). useQrDraft gained loadFields(fields, name?) (fresh unsaved draft, baseline blank, so Create's Reset/dirty logic asks before discarding); 'Use in Create' asks via useConfirm when draftApi.dirty ('Replace the Create form?'). TextField type union gained 'password'. Page test 'switches destination to Tools' now asserts the Decoder heading/aria-current; added a page test for the real Device Actions/Tools. LibraryPanel.test menu-items expectation now includes Open on device/Send to device. TOOLS: Deep Link Builder always emits scheme://host[/path][?k=v][#frag] (percent-encoded, empty keys skipped), package regex ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)+$; Wi-Fi tool is in-memory only (password never reaches storage until 'Save to library', which also exists); Decoder: file input 'Choose image' accept png/jpeg, drop, document-level paste (ignored in inputs), 10 MB, WebP/GIF message, disabled with 'Requires the desktop app' without Tauri; Quality Checker: content/colors/size/EC, 'Use current Create draft', 'Load a library record' Select (200 most recent), QualityPanel findings, 'Run scan check' round trip (desktop only). NOT DONE / LIMITS: no visual or zoom verification (jsdom only); Select pickers cap at the 200 most recently updated records; the Library 'Open on device' for a record uses record.content as saved (an untouched URL keeps its stored form); no exit animations; Capture thumbnail is the only image shown (no overlay boxes around decoded codes); Send always renders 1024 px regardless of style.size.
